citations.line: Great Synaps, who would reign from dusk to dawn,
But Synaps followed a more inward law
Synaps was born with a second jaw
For now great Synaps hunted for his sake
Great Pelyon was the first of Synaps' line—
For now Synaps walks the coal-swamp ground
Where Synaps turned his extra bones toward heat
From Synaps' lineage a different kind
To Synaps but a different road:
That Synaps' dynasty had borne: the fall
Had answered to the house of Synaps once—
Of all the heirs of Synaps' ancient line,
Of Synaps' extra jaw-bone's slow migration
Of Synaps' dynasty burning through the dark—
Of Theraps, of Pelyon, of Synaps,
Of Theraps, of Pelyon, of Synaps—
